name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
description: Free, confidential support 24/7. Call, text START to 88788, or chat at thehotline.org. Available in 200+ languages.

name: loveisrespect (teens and young adults)
description: 24/7 support for young people experiencing relationship abuse. Text LOVEIS to 22522.

name: Rainbow Services — 24/7 Crisis Hotline
description: Free, confidential 24/7 crisis line. English and Spanish. Other languages available — call and say your language.

name: Rainbow House — Emergency Shelter
description: 38 beds. VAWA-confidential location. Call for availability and safe directions. Families, children, and pets welcome.

name: Villa Paloma — Transitional Housing
description: 40 beds. Up to 24 months. Transitional housing support for rebuilding stability. VAWA-confidential location.

name: Rainbow Services — Legal Clinic
description: Attorneys, paralegals, and a victim advocate on staff. Restraining orders, immigration relief, family court support, and more.
